title: astelia pumila
intro: Astelia pumila, commonly known as the Astelia or Iron Grass, is a small, evergreen flowering plant native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including respiratory problems and inflammation. The health benefits of Astelia pumila include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia and anti-inflammatory effects.
